analysis: Examined .github/workflows/provider-tests.yml BASE lines 530–1523, including native memory/media/lifecycle gates, fixture caches, coverage and resource uploads, cluster routing, cached .git validation, release-build checks, and tested-change records. Compared the complete changed-range map and available patch. The visible patch removes cache-refresh-only builds on already-tested pushes and introduces cluster_gpu selection; it does not establish a provider runtime, authorization, encryption, billing, or cache-isolation regression. T-041's production cache controls are not changed by the visible test-only environment settings at BASE 577–588. Relevant integration concerns are build/test evidence integrity (A-011, A-017, T-054) and availability (A-018): BASE 914–1019 makes GPU tests non-blocking, while BASE 1443–1491 requires the selected blocking lanes and CI-plan checks. BASE 1503–1523 records tree/base/head and selected components for later reuse. HEAD changes to GPU selection and record generation are not replayed here, and the patch is truncated before those changes; their correctness cannot be inferred from BASE. Next integration pass should reconcile HEAD GPU job conditions, record component identity and upload conditions with provider-plan.yml and ci-tested-tree.py so reuse cannot substitute evidence from a different required test selection. Existing cache validation and external cache provenance are context, not demonstrated new vulnerabilities. No concrete regression is supported by these BASE-only units; this is not clearance of the missing HEAD behavior.
